Implemented Task 003 while preserving project and task behavior. The app now supports filtering active and archived projects, archiving and restoring projects, archived-page restrictions, and completion summaries across all tasks. Existing databases gain the archive field automatically.

Verified JavaScript syntax, `git diff --check`, and a server API smoke check covering health, tasks, summaries, archive, and restore. The working tree is clean.
